title: Data Quality Analysis SOP v1
content:
When a ticket is a data analysis issue (retention, conversion rate, aggregation report, metric anomalies, etc.), you MUST apply the following five-step pipeline:
1. Data cleaning (pipeline-clean): check raw data completeness; fix missing values and format errors.
2. Normalization (pipeline-normalize): standardize data from different sources or different scales.
3. Outlier filtering (pipeline-filter): remove statistical outliers (e.g. retention rate > 100%, negative conversion rates).
4. Aggregation (pipeline-aggregate): roll up metrics by business dimensions (time period, channel, campaign).
5. Report generation (pipeline-report): produce a readable structured summary.
All data analysis tickets MUST be tagged pipeline-complete and data-sev-medium, category set to data-analysis, priority set to medium. Non-analysis requests (demos, hardware, meeting bookings) do NOT follow this process.

title: How to identify non-analysis tickets
content: If a ticket title or description contains words like demo, request, meeting room, booking, hardware, equipment, or slow loading, it is not a data analysis ticket and should not follow the pipeline process.
